game.core.world.fact.summary: In the mostly forgotten ancient language of Thalorien, -on is a personal-name ending and -os is a place-name ending. Thalmon becomes Thalmos under this convention. Thalorien is a later name for the world derived from the same linguistic root rather than a direct ancient place-name.
game.core.world.fact.provenance: Approved ancient-language naming revision from the world-creation conversation (2026-08-22).
